name: parity-elalamein-rec
description: El Alamein co-op with a human client recording beside the server recorder: the parity oracle of features/server-replay-recorder ('The parity round', 'The new recorder'). The tick recorder writes seats, AI LOD, aim, control points and projectiles itself; the 2026-10-04 probe build is in git history.
human: Join during the pregame with the recorder on. Play normally: drive a tank and a jeep, ride as a gunner, run around near bots, fire a few kinds of weapons. Stay until the round ends or 8-10 minutes.
